sourceTitle: Walkthru Git Truly Final Verification Test
author: test-harness
intro: This article describes a final verification test for a Git-related fix, specifically addressing how build.mjs no longer queries live Workers during generation, which was the root cause of pre-publish negative cache poisoning. The test verifies that Cloudflare Workers deployments should now be visible immediately after publishing.
essay:
The article presents a synthetic test confirming that the true final fix has been implemented for a Git-related issue. **The core problem was that build.mjs was querying the live Worker during generation**, which caused pre-publish negative cache poisoning. This issue has now been resolved, and the fix ensures that Cloudflare Workers—serverless JavaScript functions deployed to a global edge network—will be visible immediately after publishing without any delay. The test was designed to verify this fix by generating enough source text to extract verbatim quotes, confirming that the build process no longer interacts with live Workers during generation.

The significance of this fix cannot be overstated. By eliminating the live Worker queries during generation, the development workflow becomes more predictable and efficient. Developers can now publish their Cloudflare Workers with confidence that they will be available globally without the previous caching issues. This represents a substantial improvement in the deployment process for serverless functions on the Cloudflare platform.
outro: The successful verification confirms that the build process no longer queries live Workers during generation, eliminating cache poisoning and ensuring immediate visibility after publishing Cloudflare Workers.
